notes: Modeled from the published Cursor plugin reference and hooks documentation; Cursor publishes no machine-readable schema. The plugin schema covers only the fields this compiler emits.
validation: Pinned JSON Schema snapshots are validated locally with Ajv. Package builds do not download schemas or invoke host-side validators.

hostLayoutObservation.source: Read-only inspection of the installed cursor-agent-exec loader and physical plugins under ~/.cursor/plugins/local.
hostLayoutObservation.notes: Local installs support root plugin.json and mcp.json; manifests select the Cursor hooks document. CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT is substituted for local MCP and hook commands. Symlinks escaping the local plugins root are rejected.
